title: Training Program Designer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners design an 8-week storytelling training program by selecting 4-6 components, sequencing them, and choosing practice formats, then see the resulting weekly schedule.

learningObjectives: Design a storytelling training program by selecting training components, sequencing them appropriately, and defining practice activities.
prerequisites: Sales Team Training and Story Workshops sections of Chapter 10

keyQuestions: Design a storytelling training program by selecting training components, sequencing them appropriately, and defining practice activities.
assessmentOpportunities: A valid program: theory and practice present, a progressive sequence, and a mix of individual and group practice.
Learner can explain why coaching works best as expert feedback.
